Q: I would like to change values that were input as zero since they were missing into null values to avoid getting errors A:

What code is returning an error message ? Perhaps you should show it.

Q: Best practices for filtering global news APIs with complex Boolean queries for media monitoring A:

My current approach uses a Boolean search query

Search in - what? Are you querying some external news API, your own database that you imported news articles into? Something else?

Is this supposed to search in one single field of text, that contains just "everything"? Are do you have any sort of structured meta data about the news articles available?

How can I refine this logic to avoid irrelevant results while ensuring I don't miss niche geopolitical updates?

How do you expect us to answer that? We don't know what makes a result "irrelevant" to you, and what "niche geopolitical updates" would be important to you.

I need a way to categorize these results by country automatically.

What information do you have available to base this on? Originating website domain/article URL? Anything else?

Q: Why I can't write in a google sheet cell with Apps script? A:

You're attempting to run the code as a custom function, i.e., by invoking it through a formula in a cell.

Custom functions cannot have side effects — they can only return a value or an array of values that will be shown in the formula cell and its friends to the right and down. This means that you cannot call Range.setValue() in a function that's run that way.

To set the value in a cell other than the formula cell, run the function through some other means, such as a button, a custom menu item, a sidebar or a trigger.
